title: Host Accounts Appeal Entitlements by Host Tier
content:
# Host Accounts — Appeal Entitlements

Roamhaven's review team decides host appeals against a suspension, a restriction, a policy strike or a cancellation penalty. The entitlements of each Host Accounts tier are:

| Host tier | Window to appeal a suspension, restriction or strike | Decision time | Appeals allowed against one decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | 30 calendar days | 10 business days | 1 |
| Standard Host | 30 calendar days | 10 business days | 1 |
| Superhost | 30 calendar days | 7 business days | 1 |
| Professional Host | 30 calendar days | 7 business days | 1 |
| Professional Host Plus | 30 calendar days | 5 business days | 1 |
| Enterprise Partner | 30 calendar days | 3 business days | 1 |

## Notes

- The window is counted in calendar days after the suspension, restriction or strike; the decision time is counted in business days.
- Every tier has one appeal per decision. A decision that has been appealed once is not appealed a second time.
